safety.title: Safety incidents
safety.description: SOS alerts, customer complaints and caregiver reports. Every change is logged with time and actor.
safety.emptyDescription: Nothing needs attention with these filters.
safety.unassigned: Unassigned (you'll be assigned on first update)
safety.escalationHint: Added to the incident's audit trail.
safety.escalationPlaceholder: What was done, who was contacted…

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.description: Mediate disagreements between customers and caregivers about a specific visit.
disputes.resolved: Dispute resolved. The party who raised it has been notified.
disputes.decisionPlaceholder: Record what was decided and any refund or follow-up action.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.description: Caregiver withdrawal requests. Approve to start processing, then mark paid once funds are transferred.
payouts.paid: Payout marked as paid. Caregiver notified.
payouts.transferred: Money transferred. The caregiver will confirm receipt.
payouts.rejected: Payout rejected. Balance released to the caregiver.
payouts.approveDescription: Moves the request to Processing. Transfer the funds, then mark it paid.
payouts.payDescription: Confirm the transfer to {account} is complete.
payouts.settlementPlaceholder: e.g. Transferred via 1Link banking portal ref #TXN123456.
payouts.rejectDescription: The earnings are released back to the caregiver's available balance.
payouts.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. Account title does not match the caregiver's CNIC name.
payouts.noteNotStored: The API doesn't save this note yet. Keep your own record of the reference.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Every payment captured across the platform, with downloadable receipts.
payments.pendingHint: The screen is ready and activates once the backend exposes GET /admin/payments.

auditLogs.title: Audit log
auditLogs.description: Append-only trail of every administrative action.
auditLogs.pendingHint: The screen is ready and activates once the backend exposes GET /admin/audit-logs.

callLogs.title: Call history
callLogs.description: Persisted in-app voice and video calls between customers and caregivers.
callLogs.pendingHint: The screen is ready and activates once the backend exposes GET /admin/call-logs.

commissions.title: Commission rates
commissions.description: Percentage of each visit fee kept by the platform, set per caregiver category. Past payments keep the rate captured when they were paid.
commissions.example: On a {fee} visit: platform keeps {platform}, caregiver receives {caregiver}.

promos.title: Promo codes
promos.description: Discount codes customers can apply to bookings.

form.description: Customers enter the code at booking checkout.
form.fixedHint: e.g. Rs 500 off the visit fee
form.errAfterStart: Must be after the start date
form.errCantClearMaxUses: A usage limit can't be removed once set. Enter a number.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.description: Operational parameters that take effect immediately, without a redeploy. Every change is audit-logged.

titles.requirePayment: Require payment before completing a visit
